_readme: Time-gated: banner shows only while enabled AND now is inside [show_start, show_end]. To go live, fill embed_url (iframe src; YouTube https://www.youtube.com/embed/<ID>?autoplay=1 or Facebook https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=<urlencoded>&show_text=false&autoplay=true), watch_url (plain YouTube/Facebook link, fallback), sponsor_logo (https URL to a PNG in osp/pages/images/) and sponsor_name. Banner stays hidden until embed_url or watch_url is set.
